ValidationRule.description: R-G12: a gift of goods or services carries the value the organization records for it, which is what its books and its giving totals count. The receipt never prints that value (R-RC11).
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter a fair market value. An in-kind gift needs the value your organization records for it, which is the same figure as the amount. It stays in Open Impact and is never printed on the donor's receipt.
